description: This PHP source file defines the AccessTokenRepository class, which manages OAuth access tokens by implementing persistence, revocation, and retrieval functions. It acts as a repository layer within an OAuth implementation for the OrangeHRM system, allowing interaction with the database to handle access token lifecycle events.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth access tokens, including creation, revocation, and retrieval. Implements the AccessTokenRepositoryInterface and utilizes Doctrine ORM to persist token data in the database.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new access token entity into the database, handling duplicate token identifiers with exception.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks an existing access token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given access token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth access token entity with specified client, scopes, and user identifier.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token record from the database by token ID.
